# Regression test for issue #37: html --lang=go WASM bridge must marshal
# slice and struct params/returns through the syscall/js boundary instead of
# passing raw js.Value where typed Go values are expected.
#
# Before the fix, .sngl-wasm-<pkg>/main.go contained
#   a0 := args[0]
#   pkg.Init(a0)        // cannot use js.Value as pkg.Config
#   result := pkg.Search(...)  // 2-value return assigned to 1 variable
# and `go build GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm` aborted compile.

sngl generate --platform=html --lang=go --opt=main=true --out=out app.sngl
exists out/server.go

-- go.mod --
module example.com/wasm-complex

go 1.23
-- api/api.go --
package api

type Config struct {
    User string
    Tag  string
}

type Result struct {
    Title string
    Score int
}

func Init(c Config) error                                      { _ = c; return nil }
func Search(jql string, fields []string, max int) ([]string, error) {
    out := make([]string, 0, max)
    for _, f := range fields {
        out = append(out, jql+":"+f)
    }
    return out, nil
}
func List() ([]Result, error) { return []Result{{Title: "x", Score: 1}}, nil }
-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"

output { go { html } }

import "go:example.com/wasm-complex/api"

component main {
    var rows list<string> = []

    window #app(title="t") {
        vbox {
            button(text="Search", @click {
                rows = api.Search("k=v", ["a","b"], 10)
            })
            text(value="count {string(rows.length)}")
        }
    }
}
